title: Agent message envelope
description: Every desk-to-desk message. Slices define the body for each type. The receiver treats the whole envelope as untrusted input until it has parsed and validated the body.

from.description: Sender desk's domain, for example cafe.test.

to.description: Receiver desk's domain, for example roaster.test.

conversationId.description: Shared by every message about one need (RFQ), from the RFQ to the invoice status.

body.description: Defined per type by the slice that introduces it.
